assistant.default_description: I'm here to help you with your studies.

default_suggestions: How do I complete a mission?
Where can I see my progress?
How does the XP system work?
How do I join a class?
teacher_suggestions: How do I create a new mission?
How do I manage my class?
How do I review student progress?
How do I assign bonus points?

teacher: How can I help you today?

m1.label: Chat about the mission
m1.message: Hi {god}, I'd like to chat about the mission "{title}"

m2.label: Ask for help
m2.message: Hi {god}, I need help with the mission "{title}"

m3.label: Let's get started!
m3.message: Hi {god}, I'm ready to start the mission "{title}". Where do I begin?

m4.label: Explain the enigmas
m4.message: Hi {god}, can you explain the enigmas in the mission "{title}"?

m5.label: Give me hints, no spoilers
m5.message: Hi {god}, I'm stuck on the mission "{title}". Can you give me a hint without spoilers?

m6.label: How do I improve my submission?
m6.message: Hi {god}, what can I do to improve my submission for the mission "{title}"?

m7.label: Summary of what I learned
m7.message: Hi {god}, give me a summary of what I should have learned from the mission "{title}"

m8.label: Get me ready for the challenge
m8.message: Hi {god}, I want to be well prepared for the challenge in the mission "{title}". What should I review?

t1.label: Create an epic mission
t1.message: I want to create an epic mission. Which class and topic should it be about?

t2.label: Creative enigma ideas
t2.message: I need creative enigma ideas for a mission. What do you suggest?

t3.label: Generate an immersive narrative
t3.message: I want to create an immersive narrative for one of my classes. Can you help?

t4.label: Design assessment criteria
t4.message: Help me design fair, motivating assessment criteria for my students.

t5.label: Suggest a themed badge
t5.message: I need ideas for a badge that motivates my students. What do you suggest?

t6.label: Improve my student guide
t6.message: I want to improve the guide I give my students. How can I make it more useful?

t7.label: Ideas to gamify a topic
t7.message: I want to gamify a topic from my subject. How would you do it?

t8.label: Create a weekly challenge
t8.message: I want to launch a weekly challenge to motivate my students. What ideas do you have?

t9.label: Strategies to motivate
t9.message: Some students are unmotivated. What gamification strategies do you recommend?

t10.label: Adapt an activity to different levels
t10.message: I have students at different levels. How can I adapt an activity for everyone?

t11.label: Write a mission guide
t11.message: I need to write a guide to introduce a mission to my students. Can you give me a hand?

t12.label: Plan a teaching sequence
t12.message: Help me plan a gamified teaching sequence step by step.

s1.label: Explain a hard topic
s1.message: There's a topic I'm struggling with. Can you explain it in a simple way?

s2.label: Give me hints for an enigma
s2.message: I'm stuck on an enigma. Can you give me a hint without spoilers?

s3.label: Tips to level up
s3.message: What can I do to earn more XP and level up faster?

s4.label: Summary of what I learned
s4.message: Give me a summary of the most important things I've learned so far.

s5.label: Help me with my submission
s5.message: I need help preparing my next submission. Can you guide me?

s6.label: Tricks to study better
s6.message: What study techniques do you recommend so I learn faster?

s7.label: Which missions do I have pending?
s7.message: Can you remind me which missions I have pending and which are most urgent?

s8.label: Motivate me to keep going
s8.message: I'm feeling a bit down. Can you motivate me to keep going?

s9.label: Explain it with an example
s9.message: I need you to explain something with a simple, practical example.

s10.label: Get me ready for a challenge
s10.message: I want to prepare properly for the next challenge. What should I review?

s11.label: How do I improve my score?
s11.message: What can I do to improve my score in the missions?

s12.label: Give me a quick quiz
s12.message: Give me a quick 5-question quiz about what we're covering in class.
